evaluation.time_scope: All training epochs through the validation-selected checkpoint
current_rank_measurements: selection rate by pre-update score decile
nonzero-gradient rate by pre-update score decile
positive and negative optimizer updates among sampled incidences
fixed_rank_measurements: selection count and logit movement by initialization-score decile
selection count and logit movement by checkpoint-score decile
initial top-K survival relative to the exact-budget chance rate

reporting_rule: Report all five runs and across-run ranges. Treat the result as a descriptive Actor-50% mechanism study; do not make a significance claim or generalize it to other datasets or budgets.

interpretation.tail_freezing: Assess whether bottom-ranked incidences are sampled, receive task gradients, and move from initialization; do not infer this from aggregate mask overlap alone.
interpretation.self_reinforcement: Report both score-increasing and score-decreasing updates among sampled incidences; do not call the process monotone if both directions occur.
interpretation.initialization_dependence: Compare initial-to-checkpoint rank correlation and top-K survival with the 50% exact-budget chance survival rate.
